chunks: From him, from Faḍālah, from Ibn Muskān, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
Qunūt in the Maghrib prayer is in the second rakʿah, and in the ʿIshāʾ and Ghadāh prayers it is likewise, and in the Witr prayer it is in the third rakʿah.

key_terms.ٱلرَّكْعَةِ ٱلثَّالِثَةِ: the third unit of the prayer
key_terms.ٱلرَّكْعَةِ ٱلثَّانِيَةِ: the second unit of the prayer
key_terms.ٱلْعِشَاءِ: the ʿIshāʾ prayer, the night salat (prayer)
key_terms.ٱلْقُنُوتُ: the supplicatory devotion recited in salat (prayer) at a designated point
key_terms.ٱلْمَغْرِبِ: the Maghrib prayer, the sunset salat (prayer)

ai.seo_question: In which rakʿah is qunūt performed in Maghrib, ʿIshāʾ, Ghadāh, and Witr prayers?
ai.summary: This hadith states the sunnah (prophetic tradition) placement of qunūt in specific prayers. It indicates that qunūt is performed in the second rakʿah of Maghrib, ʿIshāʾ, and Ghadāh, and in the third rakʿah of Witr, making it relevant to prayer rulings in Shia fiqh.
